chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) cursed whoever initiates an event (a killing) in Medina, or shelters the one who initiates it.' I said: 'What is the event?' He said: 'The killing.'

key_terms.الْمَدِينَة: Medina, the sacred city of the Prophet
key_terms.حَدَثٌ: an initiated event or incident, here meaning a killing or murder
key_terms.مُحْدِثٌ: initiator of a crime, one who commits a prohibited act

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about killing in Medina?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq narrates that the Prophet Muhammad cursed anyone who commits murder in the sacred city of Medina or shelters a murderer. When asked to clarify the meaning of 'event' (hadath), the Imam defines it as killing. This ruling underscores the special inviolability of Medina and the gravity of violating its sanctity through bloodshed, reflecting the Prophet's heightened concern for preserving the peace of his city.
